method: One recovered camera/mask solution per object from the photographs; paired dense runs differ only in patchmatch. Three identical camera views per comparison sheet.
local_sheets: patchmatch-<object>.png in .local-tools/takeover-230 (not distributed in the repository)
review_type: qualitative visual review, not new scanner scoring

objects.review: Fewer ripples around body and muzzle; ears, feet and tail remain similar. Fine photographed surface detail remains weak.
Less surface noise; hands, feet and tail remain similar. Shell grooves and small scales remain largely unresolved.
Less roughness, with no obvious loss of horns, jaw opening, limbs or tail in these views. Small scales remain poorly resolved.
More continuous robe folds. Wings and raised arm remain present in these views.
Smoother surface with similar overall silhouette; fine base ornament and engraving remain poorly resolved.

quantitative_scores: The prior six-object F1 measurements remain in crates/dense/README.md; not rerun in this review.
remaining_adoption_check: Photo-derived DTU masks and recovered cameras, with reference data confined to evaluation.
